resources.string: Check place notifications

Tap the button, lock your phone and wait. After 15 seconds Tick sends a test notification, the same kind you get at a place. This checks that notifications get through on a locked screen. It does not check your location.
Test notification in 15 seconds
Lock your phone now. The test notification comes in 15 seconds.
No test yet.
Waiting for the test notification…
Last test: the notification could not be shown, because notifications for Tick or Location notifications are off.
Last test: no notification arrived. Your phone probably stops Tick in the background. Follow the steps below and test again.
Last test: arrived %1$s, with the screen locked. Place notifications can get through.
Last test: arrived %1$s, but the screen was not locked. Test again with the screen locked.

This is how a place notification arrives. Tap to see the result.
On your %1$s
Open Tick\'s app settings

1. Settings → Apps → Tick → Battery: choose Unrestricted.\n2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: make sure Tick is not under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps. Add it to Never sleeping apps.\nThe names can differ a little per version.

1. Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Tick: turn on Autostart.
2. Same screen → Battery saver: choose No restrictions.
3. Open recent apps and lock Tick (press and hold the card, or pull it down), so cleaning up does not stop it.
The names can differ a little per version (MIUI or HyperOS).

1. Settings → Apps → Tick → Battery usage: turn on Allow background activity (and Allow auto launch, if it is there).\n2. In recent apps, lock Tick so cleaning up does not stop it.\nThe names can differ a little per version.

1. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Tick: choose Allow high background power consumption.\n2. Settings → Apps → Tick → Permissions: turn on Autostart, if it is there.\nThe names can differ a little per version.

1. Settings → Battery → App launch → Tick: turn off Manage automatically.\n2. In the window that opens, turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.\nThe names can differ a little per version.

1. Settings → Apps → Tick → App battery usage (or Battery): choose Unrestricted.\n2. Check that notifications for Tick are on, including Location notifications.\nThe names can differ a little per phone.
